interpretation: This is a deliberately non-production pilot policy for a four-family evidence seed. At the frozen two-family DEVELOPMENT allocation, the 0.80 family-error upper-bound limit admits the exact 95% Clopper-Pearson floor only when there are zero critical-family wrong accepts; one wrong-accept family fails. The policy does not establish a low population error rate.
production_boundary: The repository default 0.05 family-error upper-bound target is not weakened or replaced. A production-grade claim requires a materially larger independently reviewed corpus; at 95% confidence, 59 DEVELOPMENT families with zero wrong accepts are required even to make a 0.05 upper bound attainable.
